description: Look up a brand's AI Recommendation Rate: the percentage of buyer-intent questions where AI search picks the brand first, not just mentions it. Also returns its Recommendation Inclusion Rate: how often the brand appears anywhere in the answer. Measured on ChatGPT with search enabled, refreshed monthly. Use it to check a brand's generative engine optimization (GEO) or AI search visibility, or how visible a brand is when AI answers recommend products. Returns the brand's public record URL and measured date for citation, plus its company profile (each fact with its source link) when one is published. Free, one brand per call, rate-limited per Modern AI's published anti-scrape policy.

brand.description: Brand name to look up, e.g. "Brumate"

title: Look up a brand's AI Recommendation Rate
